summary: Restores the free-form JSON body flags the full reprint dropped as a generator artefact (activities create-activity --metadata, automations update --trigger-conditions, bulk edit-contacts/edit-deals --updates, contacts create --custom-fields, forms create --settings, integrations connect --config/--credentials, scoring-rules create --condition) and the seven typed flags of emails create-template beside --body-json; each sends the parsed JSON under its body key as before and refuses to mix with the generated sub-flags. Prose note: .printing-press-patches/reprint-637-freeform-json-flags.md.
reason: 4.28.0 prints an object with declared sub-properties as sub-flags only and a oneOf body as --body-json only, so a reprint on the full public document removed flags existing users had while the API still reads the same keys.
validated_outcome: Every restored flag is registered and its JSON lands deep-equal under its body key; malformed JSON names the flag; mixing with a sub-flag sends nothing; create-template typed flags send the pre-reprint body. TestFreeformJSONFlagsLandInTheBodyAsBefore, TestEmailsCreateTemplateTypedFlagsAsBefore.
upstream_issue: For the press board (not filed): keep a whole-object JSON flag next to sub-property flags.
